item.text: The router currently applies parameter validation, authentication, and last access tracking globally. Public access also needs to skip the required username check, so I’m splitting the router into a public endpoint on the outer router and a protected subrouter for the existing endpoints. The shared form parsing stays on the outer router, which preserves `?f=json` handling.
